question: A buyer pays Rs. 4,700 for an old scooter and Rs. 500 for repairs, then sells it for Rs. 5,800. What is the gain percentage?
questionUrdu: ایک خریدار پرانے scooter کے لیے Rs. 4,700 اور مرمت پر Rs. 500 خرچ کرتا ہے، پھر اسے Rs. 5,800 میں بیچ دیتا ہے۔ gain percentage کتنی ہے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”11.54%“ ہے۔ کل لاگت Rs. 5,200 اور منافع Rs. 600 ہے۔ منافع کو لاگت سے تقسیم کر کے 100 سے ضرب دینے پر تقریباً 11.54% حاصل ہوتا ہے۔

references.label: Solve proportions and percent applications
references.claimSummary: OpenStax defines gain percentage as gain divided by the original cost base times 100; total cost is Rs. 5,200 and gain is Rs. 600.

references.label: Calculate the scooter gain percentage
references.claimSummary: The exact gain percentage is approximately 11.538%, which rounds to 11.54%.

sourceNotes: The source's name typo was removed and option D was made exact. Total cost is 4,700+500=5,200; gain is 5,800-5,200=600; 600/5,200×100=11.54%, so D is verified.

question: A trader buys an item for Rs. 2,500, spends Rs. 500 on repairs and sells it for Rs. 3,600. What is the gain percentage?

explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”20%“ ہے۔ کل لاگت Rs. 3,000 اور منافع Rs. 600 ہے۔ Rs. 600 کو Rs. 3,000 سے تقسیم کر کے 100 سے ضرب دیں تو 20% بنتا ہے۔

references.label: Percent applications
references.claimSummary: OpenStax supports that the gain percentage on a total cost of Rs. 3,000 and sale price of Rs. 3,600 is 20%.

references.label: Gain percentage calculation
references.claimSummary: WolframAlpha supports that the gain percentage on a total cost of Rs. 3,000 and sale price of Rs. 3,600 is 20%.

sourceNotes: Original PPSC-style practice question derived from the cited authorities; it is not copied from the source book.

question: If a worker completes 1/20 of a job per day, how many days are required to finish the whole job at the same rate?
questionUrdu: اگر ایک worker روزانہ کسی کام کا 1/20 حصہ مکمل کرے تو اسی رفتار سے پورا کام کتنے دن میں ہوگا؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”20“ ہے۔ روزانہ کی شرح 1/20 کام ہے، اس لیے پورے ایک کام کے لیے 1 کو 1/20 سے تقسیم کرنے پر 20 دن آتے ہیں۔

references.label: Solve work applications
references.claimSummary: OpenStax models a work rate as the fraction of one job completed per unit time; time is the reciprocal of a constant daily rate.

references.label: Reciprocal of the daily work rate
references.claimSummary: The reciprocal of 1/20 job per day is 20 days per job.

sourceNotes: The wording was normalized. At 1/20 job per day, one job takes 20 days, answer A.

question: A worker completes 3/20 of a job per day. What fraction of the job remains after 4 days at the same rate?
questionUrdu: ایک worker روزانہ کام کا 3/20 حصہ مکمل کرتا ہے۔ اسی رفتار سے 4 دن بعد کام کا کتنا حصہ باقی رہے گا؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”2/5“ ہے۔ چار دن میں 4 × 3/20 یعنی 3/5 کام مکمل ہوگا۔ ایک پورے کام میں سے 3/5 نکالنے پر 2/5 باقی رہتا ہے۔

references.label: Work applications
references.claimSummary: OpenStax supports that 2/5 of the job remains after completing 3/20 per day for four days.

references.label: Remaining work after four days
